review_candidates.location: Qesm El Sheikh Zaid, Al Jizah, Egypt
review_candidates.description: Company Description Roboto is an education-focused organization dedicated to helping learners develop practical skills in coding, robotics, and STEM. The team designs interactive, hands-on programs that make technology and engineering concepts accessible and engaging for students of different ages. Roboto emphasizes project-based learning, creativity, and problem-solving to prepare learners for a technology-driven future. The organization values inclusive, supportive learning environments where instructors are encouraged to innovate and grow professionally. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Coding and Robotics Instructor role based in Qesm El Sheikh Zaid. The instructor will plan and deliver interactive lessons in coding, robotics, and STEM concepts, adapting teaching methods to different age groups and skill levels. Ability to work on-site in Qesm El Sheikh Zaid and manage classroom dynamics in a safe, inclusive manner. Organizational skills and reliability in preparing materials, maintaining equipment, and documenting student progress. Previous experience in youth education, after-school programs, or technology camps is an advantage.

review_candidates.title: Senior Web Developer
review_candidates.description: Club Magellano è alla ricerca di un Senior Web Developer. Siamo un tour operator in forte crescita, specializzato in viaggi in bus verso le più belle destinazioni italiane ed europee.   Per rafforzare il nostro team tecnico, cerchiamo una figura senior con esperienza consolidata nello sviluppo web, capace di lavorare su progetti complessi e contribuire attivamente all’evoluzione delle nostre piattaforme digitali.   La risorsa avrà un ruolo chiave nello sviluppo e nella definizione delle architetture software, collaborando a stretto contatto con il team tecnico, il marketing e il customer care per realizzare soluzioni scalabili, performanti e orientate al business.   Il nostro stack tecnologico è variegato: lavoriamo principalmente con Laravel e Vue.js (con Nuxt), ma gestiamo anche progetti legacy, con Angular e integrazioni custom.   Cosa farai: - Progettazione, sviluppo e manutenzione di applicazioni web complesse (frontend e backend) - Definizione e implementazione di architetture scalabili e performanti - Sviluppo e integrazione di API RESTful e servizi esterni - Ottimizzazione delle performance e della qualità del codice - Coordinamento tecnico e supporto alle figure più junior del team - Collaborazione cross-team con marketing e customer care per tradurre esigenze di business in soluzioni tecniche - Partecipazione attiva alle decisioni tecnologiche e all’evoluzione dello stack   Requisiti tecnici obbligatori: - Esperienza minima di 5 anni nello sviluppo PHP con Laravel (versioni ≥ 8.x) - Ottima conoscenza di Vue.js 3 e Nuxt - Ottima conoscenza di Angular  - Buona conoscenza di TypeScript e gestione dello stato lato frontend - Solida esperienza nella progettazione di REST API - Esperienza con sistemi di autenticazione (JWT, OAuth2) e gestione CORS - Ottima padronanza di database relazionali e ORM (Eloquent) - Utilizzo avanzato di Git e flussi di lavoro (GitFlow o simili) - Attenzione alla qualità del codice (clean code, scalabilità, manutenibilità)   Requisiti preferenziali: - Esperienza nella scrittura di test automatizzati (PHPUnit, testing frontend) - Esperienza con WebSockets / real-time (es. Laravel Echo) - Conoscenze di base DevOps e ambienti cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) - Familiarità con metodologie Agile/Scrum - Esperienza con strumenti di monitoring e logging (es. Sentry, New Relic)   Cosa offriamo: - Inserimento con contratto commisurato all’esperienza - Ruolo centrale nello sviluppo dei prodotti digitali aziendali - Autonomia e possibilità di incidere sulle scelte tecniche - Ambiente giovane, dinamico e orientato ai risultati - Collaborazione su progetti concreti e in continua evoluzione - Lavoro in sede a Tavazzano con Villavesco (LO)   Se ti appassiona costruire soluzioni solide, scalabili e concrete, e vuoi avere un impatto reale su prodotti utilizzati ogni giorno, inviaci il tuo CV.   Unisciti a Club Magellano e aiutaci a far viaggiare le emozioni!

review_candidates.title: Data Engineer
review_candidates.description: Data Engineer with Significant Impact Are you a skilled data engineer able to translate raw data to decision-ready analyses, and want to make a difference in a strong, Nordic media company with a European footprint? Story House Egmont is looking for a Data Engineer for our European technology department. We deliver great data and processes to support decisions throughout Europe. What you will be doing You’ll be a part of a small but important Data and AI team working with the media business of Story House Egmont. You’ll work closely with departments across Europe such as the Nordic marketing department, which depends on our data for their subscription business. A large amount of our work is within the Nordics, but also England with, Poland and Germany. For this position we’re looking for someone with approximately 2-5 years experience, who enjoys autonomy, responsibility and the ability to impact how we work. You don’t need to be familiar with our entire tech stack before you begin, but you must have a technical background from either work or education. You should enjoy complex challenges and be able to balance the desire for a technically elegant solution with the need to be pragmatic. It’s beneficial if you have a good understanding of business or want to learn more. You’ll be able to contribute to AI-related projects according to your own interest and capacity. Several projects have a data and an AI element, but many are also separate. Our tech stack We work with dbt models, orchestrated through Dagster, which we self-host in Kubernetes. Our data lake is in GCS. The data warehouse is in BigQuery, and we deliver reports in Power BI. Some information is also delivered through large language models. An important part of the job is including new data sources, API or file-based, into our Dagster flow. We also work on some machine learning models. You should have experience with: SQL and practical data warehouse work Python Machine learning Integrating new data sources and imports (ETL/ELT) Power BI or similar We hope you have experience with some of this: dbt Dagster BigQuery Kubernetes (we work in k8s, but it’s ran centrally) GitHub We offer: A varied workday in a fast-paced work environment Great work environment and skilled colleagues Social activities and/or clubs depending on the country, company cabins/summer house, and more! An important role in a renowned media company This is a permanent position in the team Data & AI, and reports to Data & AI Manager Henrik Hildre. The team is a part of a European technology department with teams working on content systems, web development, data and subscription systems. Our head office is in Copenhagen, and the technology department has employees in Oslo, Stockholm, Malmö, København and Warszawa. We believe data engineers from all backgrounds will feel welcome with us! The working language is Norwegian, Swedish or Danish. You’ll have some meetings in English too. For this position we’re hiring in Norway, Sweden and Denmark. You’ll be formally hired in the country you’re in, with local terms and a base in the relevant office (Oslo, Malmö, Copenhagen). Application deadline is September 30th 2026. We’ll have interviews on a rolling basis and could make quick decisions for the right candidate. We don’t work with recruitment companies, please apply personally. Regarding AI applications: This job description was not written with AI, and we have no AI systems automatically screening applications or CVs. All applications are read and considered by the head of the team. To make it easier to separate your opinions from that of an AI agent, please don’t write a long and complex application with your AI assistant. We’d love to see a human paragraph or two about what you think is interesting about the position, why you’re applying and what you can contribute with at Story House Egmont. We’re looking for a great data engineer, not perfect language. Should you have any questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact: Henrik Hildre, Manager Data & AI, henrik.hildre@egmont.com. Please click “Apply” to apply – we do not accept applications via email. About Story House Egmont Story House Egmont publishes magazines, comics, books, and digital services for adults, children, and young people. We are also a co-owner of several successful companies within e-commerce and marketing services. Our motto – We bring stories to life – is rooted in strong publishing values. We create great content and world-class journalism, and develop engaging consumer communities and brands. Story House is part of Egmont, one of the leading media groups in the Nordic region. Egmont is behind TV 2, Nordisk Film, Cappelen Damm, and Lindhardt og Ringhof in Denmark. Egmont is a foundation where all profits are reinvested into developing our companies, helping vulnerable children and youth, and supporting film talent. We are passionate about creating everyday magic, both for our customers and in our day-to-day work life. Here, you will meet dedicated, positive, and adaptable colleagues who care about one another and work together toward a shared goal. We believe in the value of our differences and diverse perspectives. It is through diversity and varied viewpoints that great stories are born. We therefore warmly welcome diversity.

review_candidates.title: Ubuntu Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Ubuntu Software Engineer based in Germany. Join a globally distributed engineering environment working on one of the world’s most widely adopted open source operating systems. This role offers the opportunity to contribute across the Ubuntu Engineering organization, from foundational systems and server technologies to desktop platforms and archive maintenance. You will design, build, package, test, integrate, and ship software that supports millions of users worldwide. Depending on your expertise, you may work with Rust, Go, Python, Flutter, C/C++, Linux distributions, packaging systems, or build automation. The position combines hands-on software engineering with system-level problem solving and collaboration across a global open source community. You will have opportunities to contribute upstream, improve engineering processes, document technical solutions, and mentor colleagues. This is an ideal opportunity for a mid-career engineer who wants to deepen their technical expertise while making a meaningful impact on open source software. Accountabilities Design, develop, test, and ship new foundational systems software and applications using technologies such as Rust, Go, Python, Flutter, and C/C++. Package, integrate, test, maintain, and upload open source software to Ubuntu repositories using Debian and Snap packaging mechanisms. Engineer integrations across the software stack, from boot firmware and core system components to cloud application deployments. Build and maintain automation and engineering infrastructure responsible for building, testing, and shipping Ubuntu. Contribute to the maintenance, evolution, and overall quality of a Linux distribution and its repositories. Investigate and resolve system-level issues, delivering reliable, robust, and maintainable solutions. Author and improve technical documentation and community documentation to support users and fellow engineers. Contribute to upstream and related open source projects while actively participating in the broader open source community. Collaborate effectively within a globally distributed engineering organization and share knowledge by mentoring colleagues. Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes and increase the efficiency and quality of software delivery. Requirements 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience after completing university, with a demonstrated record of delivering high-quality technical work. Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related discipline, or a compelling alternative professional or educational background. Strong academic performance and a demonstrated drive to exceed expectations. Significant hands-on experience with at least one of Rust, Go, Python, Flutter, or C/C++. Genuine passion for open source software and an interest in contributing to large-scale open source projects. Professional proficiency in written and spoken English, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively in a globally distributed environment and collaborate across teams and cultures. Willingness and ability to travel internationally approximately twice per year for company events lasting up to two weeks. Experience with Linux distributions and distribution engineering is highly desirable. Knowledge of software packaging and distribution mechanisms is an advantage. Understanding of build systems, toolchains, and cross-compilation is beneficial. Experience in performance engineering or security engineering is a plus. Benefits Distributed work environment with opportunities to collaborate in person during twice-yearly team sprints. Compensation determined according to geographical location, experience, and performance. Annual compensation reviews, with more frequent reviews where appropriate for graduates and associates. Performance-driven annual bonus. USD 2,000 annual personal learning and development budget. Recognition rewards for outstanding contributions. Annual holiday leave. Maternity and paternity leave. Team Member Assistance Program and Wellness Platform. Opportunities to travel to new locations and meet colleagues from around the world. Priority Pass access and travel upgrades for long-haul company events. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
